record.bible_text: And there was a great<WH01419> cry<WH06818> of the people<WH05971> and of their wives<WH0802> against their brethren<WH0251> the Jews<WH03064>.

Moreover <FI>there were<Fi> at my table<WH07979> an hundred<WH03967> and fifty<WH02572><WH0376> of the Jews<WH03064> and rulers<WH05461>, beside those that came<WH0935><WTH8802> unto us from among the heathen<WH01471> that <FI>are<Fi> about us<WH05439>.

Now <FI>that<Fi> which was prepared<WH06213><WTH8737> <FI>for me<Fi> daily<WH03117> <FI>was<Fi> one<WH0259> ox<WH07794> <FI>and<Fi> six<WH08337> choice<WH01305><WTH8803> sheep<WH06629>; also fowls<WH06833> were prepared<WH06213><WTH8738> for me, and once in ten<WH06235> days<WH03117> store<WH07235><WTH8687> of all sorts of wine<WH03196>: yet for all<WH05973> this required<WH01245><WTH8765> not I the bread<WH03899> of the governor<WH06346>, because the bondage<WH05656> was heavy<WH03513><WTH8804> upon this people<WH05971>.
Think<WH02142><WTH8798> upon me, my God<WH0430>, for good<WH02896>, <FI>according<Fi> to all that I have done<WH06213><WTH8804> for this people<WH05971>.<CM>
